Glyos colorway metadata

Source: R/palettes.R
glyos_colorways.Rd

Background information for every palette in glyos_palettes: the company and product line it comes from, the colorway name as the manufacturer uses it, the year and wave of the reference release where known, a plain-language description of the colors, the reference figure whose photograph the palette was sampled from, and a link to that figure's entry in the Official Glyos Database (Onell Design) or the Glyos Wiki (partner companies).

Usage

glyos_colorways

Format

A data frame with one row per palette and the columns:

palette

Palette name, as used by glyos_palette().

company

Company that produced the colorway, e.g. "Onell Design" or "TheGodBeast". See glyos_companies().

line

Product line, e.g. "Glyos", "Kabuto Mushi" or "Battle Tribes".

colorway

Colorway or figure name as used by the manufacturer.

year

Year of the reference release, or NA where not recorded.

wave

Release wave or series of the reference release, or NA.

n_colours

Number of colors in the palette.

description

Description of the plastic and paint colors.

reference_figure

Figure the palette was sampled from.

source

URL of the reference figure's page.

image

Direct URL of the reference photograph the palette was sampled from, hosted by the Official Glyos Database or the Glyos Wiki.

Source

Official Glyos Database, https://database.glyos.com/; the Glyos Transmission Web Log, https://onelldesign.blogspot.com/; and the Glyos Wiki, https://glyos.fandom.com/.

Examples

head(glyos_colorways)
#>     palette      company  line    colorway year    wave n_colours
#> 1  standard Onell Design Glyos    Standard 2015 Wave 49         4
#> 2   reverse Onell Design Glyos     Reverse 2013 Wave 28         4
#> 3   spectre Onell Design Glyos     Spectre 2012 Wave 23         4
#> 4     hades Onell Design Glyos Hades Force 2015 Wave 51         4
#> 5 infection Onell Design Glyos   Infection 2013 Wave 27         4
#> 6 neo_phase Onell Design Glyos   Neo Phase 2013 Wave 26         4
#>                                                                                                          description
#> 1 Light blue and grey plastic with grey painted eyes and grey detail lines; the original Pheyden colors from Wave 1.
#> 2                                  Grey and light blue plastic (the Standard colors swapped) with pink painted eyes.
#> 3                                                       Glow-in-the-dark green plastic with aqua green painted eyes.
#> 4                                           Black plastic with aqua green accents and a glow-in-the-dark green head.
#> 5                                                         Clear red plastic, originally developed with The GodBeast.
#> 6                                                                  Clear neon green plastic with green painted eyes.
#>          reference_figure
#> 1   Standard Pheyden MK V
#> 2   Reverse Pheyden MK II
#> 3   Spectre Pheyden MK II
#> 4     Hades Pheyden MK IV
#> 5       Infection Exellis
#> 6 Neo Phase Pheyden MK II
